0022600177.text: The Knicks (3-4, 8th in the East and 3.5 games back in the Atlantic) host the Bulls (1-6, 15th in the East), who have lost five straight and are 0-2 at home, while New York is coming off a win and is 2-2 at home. Chicago is missing Nic Claxton, who is out with a hamstring injury. New York leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 133-127 win in Chicago on October 28, and the Knicks won the 2025-26 series 3-1.
